propositions: BindingStore.unbind() conditionally removes reverse entries only when the forward entry contains a jira_key, leaving orphaned reverse keys when forward entries lack jira_key or are removed through other code paths
Orphaned reverse index entries are reported indefinitely by bridge fsck store_integrity audit as reverse_missing_forward faults but cannot be cleaned up through any public API surface
Concurrent merge conflicts in bindings.json can drop forward entries wholesale via merge=ours strategy without corresponding reverse index cleanup, producing permanent drift
unbind() must sweep the reverse index for residual keys pointing to the deleted local_id after removing the forward entry, making cleanup unconditional and self-contained

A supported --repair verb on rebar bridge fsck with pre-write guards must clean orphaned reverse entries only when all store_integrity findings are reverse_missing_forward and no orphan has a forward binding or retired entry
